notes.title: Chapter 5 & 6 + Endless Mode Update with Historical 12% Discount!

Check out all the new things we bring to you in the Dungeon Inn![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44492140/68d30d7ed798720997672f7b5d7a6f8ca7a121bd.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]Additionally, Dungeon Inn is currently having a historical discount of 12% off! So now is the perfect time to introduce Dungeon Inn to your friends and family! :)[/b][/p][hr][/hr][h2]Update Content：[/h2][h3][b]1.An Exciting Continuation: A Detective "Pokes" Around[/b][/h3][p]Chapter 5 and Chapter 6 brings a continuation to where we left off at Dungeon Inn and new challenges![/p][p]The Dungeon Inn welcomes a prickly guest in the form of the Chestnut Detective, Chever, who keeps dropping by for surprise visits. What will he bring to the Dungeon Inn? Meanwhile, even adventurers, who brave the dungeons, aren't able to brave the unbearable heat.[/p][p]But every enterprising boss knows: Risk = Opportunity![/p][p]What clever scheme will Sara come up notes.title: Devlog: Working on our major update!!
notes.notes: [p]Hello Innkeepers![/p][p][/p][p]Lately, we started growing rocket growing in front of our Homebase HQ but some pesky caterpillars ate it all up, leaving nothing behind. And now they have turned into pupae... [/p][p][/p][p]But you don't want to hear about our gardening problems! You're here for more news about Dungeon Inn![/p][p][/p][p]We are still hard at work investigating the issue that prevents the game from progressing after the prologue scene when the game is first launched. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause. We will do our best to resolve this issue as soon as possible![/p][p][/p][p]We've been going through some internal testing and modifications of both the Endless Mode and the story chapter. We are also working to improve the inn's growth mechanic such as how the facility upgrades in the game and skill upgrades. It was honestly quite nerve-wracking reviewing the entire game's system and content that we created in the past and we have to be careful not to accidentally break the game![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44492140/29371602c1792751a1b903a458c8d3ce4f81af09.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]And of course, we will be working on the story continuation of Dungeon Inn and the troublesome Chestnut Detective. We will also be adding new ways to play the game, such as including some not-so-fun parts of summer (ahem heat waves ahem)! How will Sara and friends navigate this obstacle that turns guests away?[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44492140/76a2382c98a9f78143e21eadf981b5abab680e29.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]The new chapters and Endless Mode will be available in July![/b] Just in time for summer, am I right? [/p][p][/p][p]We are very excited for you to give Endless Mode a shot and we cannot wait to hear what you think of this game mode! We hope you'll enjoy what we have prepared. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44492140/c06aa8a3ace6696b3d995210510f6256d39112ce.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]If you have any suggestions or bugs, we would be delighted to hear from you through [url="https://forms.gle/LBSwV1LvRiZx3DNs7"]this Google form[/url]. [/p][p][/p][p]For all the latest updates and news, please also follow us on social media:[/p][p][url="https://x.com/_DungeonInn"]Dungeon Inn Twitter[/url] [/p][p][url="https://discord.com/invite/qXZyYvrr9s"]Dungeon Inn Discord[/url] [/p][p][url="https://www.tiktok.com/@cozy.dungeon.inn"]Dungeon Inn Tiktok[/url][/p]

notes.title: 0.5.250411 Update - Added Monthly Goals and New Adventurers
notes.notes:
Dear Innkeepers, the wait is over!
The latest update for Dungeon Inn is now live on Steam!

This update is entirely based on valuable feedback from our player community. We've carefully listened to every innkeeper's suggestions and will continue implementing the features and optimizations you're looking forward to!

✨ ​​Update Highlights​​ ✨
[list]
[*] New ​​"Monthly Challenge" System​​
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44492140/91a74f1272d9784947efe749e7b9f1e452f226c1.jpg[/img]
[*] ​​New Adventurers Arriving!​​ The inn is about to welcome mysterious guests!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44492140/1a7d90511a5b0e758da7bd6b2059a1e9c65ba7fc.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44492140/5be9d489ec00953619be683261a749c4d9722830.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44492140/50a18222064f0caa6797d6c3dffcf65e7eda1f61.gif[/img]
[/list]
[b]Dungeon Inn is now available at a ​​12% discount​​ – its lowest historical price! If you enjoy the game, please recommend it to your friends and family![/b]
-----------
(1) Monthly Goal
[list]
[*] The Monthly Goals are added to each chapter.
[*] You earn points for achieving the monthly goal item, and your chapter rank is determined by the number of points you have earned.
[/list]
(2) New Adventurers
[list]
[*] New Expert Adventurers and have been added.
[*] New Master Adventurers and their Adventurer Events have been added.
[/list]
(3) Etc.
[list]
[*] “Gotta Reap What You Sow” quest improvement: Quest markers are given to guests who should receive them(Week 15, Chapter 4).
[*] If the adventurer is associated with a quest, you can check which quest the adventurer is associated with in the character information window in the stage.
[*] Each Master Adventurer has their own favorite facilities, and you can check which facilities they like in the character information window on the stage.
[*] The problem where the combat/death information of adventurers was not properly displayed in the Collection has been resolved.
[*] Adventurers are displayed in the Collection divided into pages by Adventurer Grade.
[/list]
[b](Caution)
When updating to a new version, you cannot use the stage data for “Continue” from the previous version, and you can continue playing from the lobby scene by “Load”.[/b]
----------
If you have any other questions or feedback about the game, please feel free to let us know via the Steam Community Discussion, Steam Comments, or Discord. Thank you!

notes.title: 0.5.250305 Update - Support for Game Controllers and Added Function to Continue
notes.notes:
Hello!

We're excited to announce the details of our new update, which we've prepared based on the feedback we've received from you all!

[h3](1) Support for Game Controllers[/h3]
You can now enjoy <Dungeon Inn> with a game controller!
If you have any inconveniences while playing with the game controller or have any other good ideas on how to control it, please let us know! We will wait for you.

[h3](2) New Function - Continue Stage[/h3]
You can now stop playing a stage and continue from the title scene.
Please note that you can only continue from the last point you stopped at.

----------
If you have any other questions or feedback about the game, please feel free to let us know via the Steam Community Discussion, Steam Comments, or Discord. Thank you!

notes.title: 0.5.241220 Update
notes.notes:
Hello!

We would like to inform you of the details of the new update prepared based on the feedback we received from you!

[b](1) Added a new difficulty level and adjusted the existing difficulty levels[/b]

A new difficulty level,[b] ‘Enjoyable,’[/b] has been added!

This difficulty level is for those who want to play the game a little harder than the existing ‘Casual’ difficulty level, but a little easier than the ‘Courageous’ difficulty level.

The difficulty levels of ‘Casual’ and ‘Courageous’ have been adjusted slightly to make ‘Casual’ a little easier and ‘Courageous’ a little more difficult, and the amount of tribute money that must be paid each month has been adjusted to match the difficulty level. In addition, the amount of special tokens that players can earn at the time of monthly settlement has been adjusted starting from Chapter 2.

[b](2) Tutorials can be viewed on the stage[/b]

You can now view the contents of the tutorials you have learned so far through the ‘System > Game Guide’ menu on the stage.

[b](3) Added the feature to save after playing the last chapter[/b]

If you clear the stage that corresponds to the last story in the story provided in the current version, you can save the clear data. If a new story is added in the future, you can load the clear data and continue playing.

[b](4) Other convenience improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] In the Lobby, a button has been added to [b]skip the event played through the Collection[/b].
[*] Some UI has been improved to provide more friendly information regarding the success and failure of goals within a stage.
[/list]
[b](5) Major bug fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where ‘Special Token’ should have been given according to the level of the tribute, but was given according to the rank.
[list]
[*]  If you start a new game, you will receive ‘Special Token’ according to the rules every time you complete the settlement every month
[*]  If you load existing saved data, you will continue to receive additional ‘Special Token’.
[/list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the monthly settlement rank and the money in Sara's pocket were not being saved properly.
[list]
[*]  When you load your previous data, all previous months will be recorded as cleared with S rank, and the amount of money in Sara's pocket will be recorded as an estimated amount based on the gold you have earned so far.
[/list][/list]
We sincerely apologise for any inconvenience caused.

[b](6) Other bug fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the ‘Game Guide’ list and the ‘Events’ list in the Collection were not updated on time.
[*] Fixed an issue where the game would not progress if the amount of money earned each month was low on the monthly settlement screen.
[/list]

----------

If you have any other questions or feedback about the game, please feel free to let us know via the Steam Community Discussion, Steam Comments, or Discord. Thank you!

notes.title: Demo Update 2024.05.02
notes.notes:
Hello, there!
This is Cat Society!


[h2][u]What's in the Update[/u][/h2]

In this update, we've added the following:

[h3][b]Added Difficulty mode[/b][/h3]

You can now enjoy <Dungeon Inn> by selecting a difficulty level.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44492140/49be80b34a2d65099f42315faacb9f84e07eeb88.jpg[/img]

You can choose the difficulty level when you start a new game, and you can also change it at any time during the game from the lobby scene.

The difficulty level determines the level of objectives you need to achieve in a stage, and the amount of money you need to send to the Dragon each month. For now, we're keeping the game at two difficulty levels, but we may adjust the number of levels in the future after hearing from players.


[h3][b]Added Monthly Settlements and Commissions[/b][/h3]

Sara's contract with the dragon requires her to send the dragon some (or most!!) of the inn's profits every month. During the last week of each month, she must report to the dragon on how she's been doing!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44492140/7ad4f969c41f7b3663aca1727c70b953bf678d41.gif[/img]

And along with adding a Monthly Settlements scene, we've also improved the Stage Results screen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44492140/c3940a2232af251b53d7f6dec9bb4390bf2febf1.jpg[/img]


[h3][b]Added Selection Constraints by Ability[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44492140/d50d7ce5fb3c5515adeb4828bf0ccb83da32b429.jpg[/img]

When a stage event occurs, certain options will only be available to you if you have a high level of the relevant ability. The higher your each ability level, the easier it will be to make choices that benefit your Inn.


[h2][u]Improved Visual Effects[/u][/h2]

In this build, we focused a lot on making the <Dungeon Inn> more interesting to look at.

First, as mentioned in a previous devlog, we're highlighting adventurers using the Inn on the 'Today's Lodge' menu screen. Previously, we used to show adventurer icons on top of the room/facility tiles, but in this build, we've switched to showing adventurers in motion alongside the faction-specific inn layout.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44492140/86a4a8c68d18db9ab81a5533b20c0ee2e1618c34.gif[/img]

On the stage main screen, we've also enhanced the way we display which rooms and facilities adventurers stay in and use when they visit the inn each turn. Previously, it was simply represented like a log, but we've changed it up by showing the room/facility tiles and putting an adventurer icon on top of them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44492140/07c774588de5f9e04e2168d76c0f86e490c510d2.gif[/img]


[hr][/hr]

Our next update, scheduled for June 2024, will prepare us for the upcoming CBT. We've laid the groundwork for <Dungeon Inn> with the "soft-opening" story, but now we'll focus on expanding it. We'll keep you updated on our progress.

Stay tuned for new characters to meet, and more stories for Sara and her friends to tell!

Thank you.

notes.title: Demo Update 2024.04.05
notes.notes:
Hello, there!
This is Cat Society!


[h2][u]What's in the Update[/u][/h2]

In this update, we've added the following:

[h3][b]Changed UI/UX at 'Manage Inn'(for Facility Expansion)[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44492140/f3063b24f496d6260c39667c668c33bd7528b936.png[/img]
Even before purchasing a new facility, we made it possible for them to see how their revenue and reputation would change with the addition of that facility. We also displayed information about the possible Events of adding a facility.


[h3][b]New Events[/b][/h3]

As adventurers use cafes, taverns, and training room, Sara is exposed to a variety of things that happen to them.  In this build, we've added new ones, and we've changed the types of things that happen based on guild.


[h3][b]Unified Fame Types[/b][/h3]

We've consolidated the three types of fame for each faction into one, and changed the way fame is earned when adventurers visit inns instead of only when they use the inn's facilities.


[h3][b]Ability[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44492140/8de06707580aaa8fb99567777e338d569a4e8b19.png[/img]
"Ability" increases when using facilities or solving cases. Ability is a number that is managed in common across guilds. It's used as a condition for purchasing new facilities or being able to choose special options in Events. However, the facility purchasing and Events selection constraints are not reflected in this first week of April build, and will be reflected in the next April build.


[h3][b]New Language Added - French[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44492140/34df1dcbb44a5956ecd686d7ebddb9fc280dbd6c.png[/img]
Now you can enjoy the stories of Sara and her friends in French!


[h2][u]Upcoming Development Schedule[/u][/h2]

Coming in April, we'll be making the following changes:

1) Separate difficulty levels
   - When you launch the game, you'll be able to select a difficulty level to progress.

2) Ability Level System Improvements
   - Your Ability level will limit your options for purchasing and unlocking facilities.

3) Reflect adventurers' use of facilities
   - You can now see how adventurers are using your facilities on the in-stage Inn information screen.

4) Commissions and Gold Tokens
   - You can earn Gold Tokens by sending a portion of the money you've saved during the month to the Dragon.
   - However, the gold tokens are not available in the demo version as they will be redeemed in the following month.


[hr][/hr]

Thank you!

notes.title: About the 2024 Development and Release Schedule
notes.notes:
Hello, there! This is Cat Society!

We've made it through Taipei Game Show 2024, and then the Steam Next Festival last month. We were blown away by how much more people enjoyed Sara and her friends' story than we expected, from all over the world. It made us very happy and energized! It also taught us a lot about the direction of Dungeon Inn, so we'd like to take this opportunity to thank you all one more time for your interest in Dungeon Inn and for playing it. We'd also like to take this opportunity to apologize for the unfortunate delay in our development schedule.


[h2][u]Delayed EA Release Date (24.Jun. → 2024.Nov.) & Closed Beta Coming soon [/u][/h2]

At the start of the Steam Next festival, we had planned to release Early Access in June 2024. However, after careful consideration of the feedback we received at the festival and the advice we received both inside and outside of the game, we've decided to push the Early Access release date to this fall in order to greet you with a more polished game when it launches. Instead, we're going into closed beta with the build that was originally scheduled for Early Access.

Again, we sincerely apologize for the delay and ask for your patience and understanding.


[h2][u]What's Coming Up?[/u][/h2]

Based on the feedback we received at the Steam Next festival, we're working on the following.

[h3][b]Divide the Difficulty Level[/b][/h3]

[i]"Who should Dungeon Inn be a game for?"[/i]

This is a question we've been asking ourselves since we first announced <Dungeon Inn>.

I think the key to <Dungeon Inn>, and I'm a little embarrassed to say this, is its compelling art and unique gameplay. Art is a first impression. Attractive art greatly lowers the barrier of entry to a gameAnd play is what keeps people in the game, and we're trying to provide original and strategic play in Dungeon Inn.

Here's the problem. Based on the art alone, Dungeon Inn appeals to a light/casual/cozy gamer, but the gameplay is aimed at a midcore gamer. The players that the two elements appeal to are split. One of the things we heard a lot from people who visited our booth at  exhibitions was, "The art looks casual, but the game isn't as easy as I thought it would be." 

At a game show in Korea, one of the things we heard from people who visited our booth was, "The art looks casual, but the game isn't as easy as I thought it would be." Some people said the game was too hard, and some said it was too easy. In that situation, we were developing the game in the direction of making the difficulty a little easier and improving the UI/UX convenience as much as possible to make it easier to understand the gameplay, since we couldn't satisfy all players.

And then after the Steam Next festival. We heard from enough people. And we realized we didn't have to aim for a single point between the two groups. We thought, why not just split the difficulty between easy and hard? People who want to relax and enjoy the story of Sara and her friends can play the easy mode, while those who want a more tense and strategic approach to the game can play the hard mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44492140/be6b5d488a7d3a905258f1a396c201098af7667b.png[/img]

There will be some slight differences in level design between difficulty levels, but since it's a story-driven game, the gimmick mix per stage won't change much, nor will the final rewards in the game. We've learned a lot from the Steam Next festival about what people struggle with, and we'll be able to place the right amount of tension and randomization in the game depending on the difficulty level.

[h3][b]Intergrating Fame And Adding Managing Ability EXP[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44492140/2f19df812597b62e5c3781c60a318227bcb0f00e.png[/img]
We're combining the Fame that was divided into 'Entertainment', 'Dining', and 'Dungeoneering' into one Fame, and simplifying the 'Earn basic fame when visiting + additional fame when using facilities' to 'Earn fame when visiting'.

Instead, we've added the notion that using an establishment increases its 'Ability', which is divided into three categories: 'Operations', 'Service', and 'Food', and unlike Fame, is a number that is managed in common across guilds. This factor is used as a condition for purchasing new facilities, as well as to select special options in various Happenings. This skill is primarily increased when guests use the relevant facilities.

[h3][b]Changing Term Around Suspicious : Suspicious Level → Battle Count[/b][/h3]
In "Dungeon Inn", 'Suspicions' and 'Suspicion Levels' are used as threats to detection of double-dealing business. We're replacing the term 'Suspicion Levels' with a more intuitive term, "Battle Count," because the two terms have very similar names, which can be confusing to players and cause translation issues.

[h3][b]More Emphasis on Adventurers Using Inns[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44492140/43c4950075ee695f07207360a6b622a5b133f8a1.png[/img]
In stage, we want to show players how adventurers spend their time when they stay at the Inn. So we're changing the structure and apperance of the Inn's interior, and whereas previously we only showed the adventurer's use of the facility as an icon, we now want to show the adventurer moving through the facility.

[h3][b]Gold Tokens and Sara's Secret Room[/b][/h3]
What happens to Sara's hard-earned money while she's open?

While earning money was presented as a goal in the stages, there wasn't a specific place to spend all the money - it was kind of like a score. Going forward, in each theme, a percentage of the money Sara earns will be converted into Gold Tokens, which player can use like a joker to purchase facilities. And any leftover money will be used to decorate her room!

[h2][u]Upcoming Development Schedule[/u][/h2]
Including the above enhancements, the development schedule for <Dungeon Inn> in 2024 looks like this.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44492140/fccd5f3852669496a1d1bd2ccc572c1bf99dbb78.png[/img]

[h3][b]2024.Apr. : Update Demo[/b][/h3]
The April release will only add the following from the February release.
- Separate difficulty levels, intergrating fame, and adding abilities

[h3][b]2024.Jun. : Do Closed Beta [/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Add 8 stages (total 12 stages)
[*] Add character skill system
– As the story progresses, each character gains skills.
– You can choose one of the character skills and use it on the stage.
[*] Additional facilities and facility upgrade system
– New facilities will be available to purchase.
– You can upgrade facilities(Normal Tavern -> Sports Pub or Tavern with Bar, etc.).
[*] Add facility usage visualizations
– You can see the adventurers using the facility on the stage.
[/list]
[h3][b]2024.Nov. : Release Early Access[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] ncorporate feedback from closed beta testing and polish the game.
[*] Add achievements
[*] Add a new stage
[*] New character appears
[/list]
[h3][b]2025 : Release Full Version[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] We're releasing it with all 48 stages in total.
[*] Reflect secondary elements such as collections, decorations, etc.
[*] Add unlimited mode
[/list]

[hr][/hr]

We're so sorry to announce that we've had to delay our release date once again, following the delay late last year. We appreciate your patience, and we're looking forward to showing you a more polished game.

We hope you'll stick with us and Sara on this journey until the end.

Thank you very much.

Best Regards,
Cat Society

It's been a while since we've posted here. In the meantime, we've been working hard to make our demo more advanced.

In this update, we've made the following improvements to it.


[h2]- Added a prologue scene[/h2]
We've added a prologue that tells the story of how Sara and her friends came to open the inn in front of the dungeon.

Players can now earn guild-specific tokens by completing quests in Stages. Guild-specific tokens can be used to expand various facilities (rooms, amenities) in each guild's loading for Adventurers.

Previously, Rooms and Facilities tiles were managed and expanded separately for each lodging. Now, you can unlock tiles for each lodging using Guild Tokens instead of Gold.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44492140/56e70a8f5d304ded31a2aafa7c452f5ce764a9e3.png[/img]
